javelin.speaker: object
javelin.text: Peltast troops commonly used javelins, and hoplites and cavalry troops were also often equipped with javelins for throwing.

javelin.speaker: object
javelin.text: The javelins used were light spears around 1.5 meters in length, with a bronze head to facilitate recovery of the weapon.

javelin.speaker: object
javelin.text: Javelins were also used in the Ancient Olympics and other Panhellenic games.

javelin.speaker: object
javelin.text: They were hurled in a certain direction and whoever hurled it the farthest, as long as it hit tip-first, won that game.
